2843-3175-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1322-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1322-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1322-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

104-4716-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4716-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-2185-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Howlgeist enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Howlgeist enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
413-2185-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1052-3175-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

774-4543-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}.
774-4543-6763.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trench Behemoth twice by returning two lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-3986.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
3259-3480-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4017-4050-5086-5183-6705.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-4050-5086-5183-6705.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

586-1472-5231-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-5231-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

586-2510-5258-5618-6797.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
586-2510-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

645-1267-2719-6797.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2719-6797.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Repeat each turn.

457-2232-3719.easyPrerequisites: You control four or more artifacts.
457-2232-3719.description:
Cast Urza by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return Ruthless Technomancer from the battlefield to your hand if its on the battlefield, or nothing otherwise.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Construct, adding {U}.
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Construct and create a number of Treasure tokens equal to its power.
Holding priority, activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Treasure, adding {U}.
Repeat step 9 until you have {5}{U}{U} total available or until you have one untapped Treasure remaining.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Urza from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
457-2232-3719.notes:
The additional mana cost may be waived or reduced depending on how many artifacts you control as you start the combo. You can also use artifacts you control to tap them via Urza's first ability, reducing the possible cost down to {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

3334-3484-4365-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3334-3484-4365-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

440-1339-1939-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1939-2034.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
When the Insect dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-1115-2438.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1115-2438.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

618-2034-2732.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Prowling Geistcatcher with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki, adding {C}{C}.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, the nontoken and token Prowling Geistcatcher's first abilities trigger.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Ashnod'sAltar by sacrificing the Prowling Geistcatcher token, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2173-2438-2932-5220.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2438-2932-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
2173-2438-2932-5220.notes: The creature with mana value 1 or less can be Carrion Feeder, if desired. However, you will forego putting infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

2034-3748-3902.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to give Hornet Nest indestructible.
2034-3748-3902.description:
Give Hornet Nest indestructible, if needed.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Hornet Nest.
Hornet Nest triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Insect creature tokens equal to the damage dealt.
When the Insect(s) enters the battlefield, Halana triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Halana trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal 1 damage to Hornet Nest.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2034-2946-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {C}{C}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

914-2603-4558.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2603-4558.description:
Cast Worthy Cause with buyback by paying {2}{W} and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Extus triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Worthy Cause, causing you to gain life equal to Dockside Extortionist's toughness and return Worthy Cause to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, if Extus is your commander, you may instead sacrifice Extus, and then infinitely cast Awaken the Blood Avatar to cause all opponent to sacrifice all creatures they control, and create infinite 3/6 Avatar creature tokens with haste.

565-568-2793.description:
Cast Capsize paying for buyback targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
The token copy of Ugin's Nexus is put into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ugin's Nexus copy triggers, exiling itself and you take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Capsize returning itself and Ugin's Nexus to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus.
Repeat.

539-1247-5175.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-5175.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
